scope: Native isolated ecology B Page: direct mascot reaction renders within the picture window without progress changes.
evaluationSource: async function(){const p=getCurrentPages().slice(-1)[0],before=JSON.stringify(p.data.snapshot),id=p.data.journey.guideId;p.mascotTap({currentTarget:{dataset:{id}}});await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,120));const q=wx.createSelectorQuery();q.select(".chapter-cheer").boundingClientRect();q.select(".chapter-active").boundingClientRect();q.select(".chapter-active .chapter-art-window").boundingClientRect();const rect=await new Promise(r=>q.exec(r));return {id,responding:p.data.motion.respondingId,unchanged:before===JSON.stringify(p.data.snapshot),rect};}
